campaign: Complete integrated platform validation, then transfer validated audio.cpp behavior into reusable audio primitives and composable ingest-train-evaluate-serve recipes
doctrine: Operator override (2026-09-04): work and commit only in overgo_audiocpp; do not merge master or push. Each due sync row reconciles the current committed audio baseline and stored authorities, updates affected remaining rows, and commits through cmd/gate before its paired work row. Record the exact baseline at dispatch; retained baseline d692645c is a minimum ancestor, not permission to chase master. Reconciliation commits and work commits remain separate. Resume master synchronization only on explicit authorization, using cmd/plan -prepare-merge master -plan-projection first-parent-target and its gated merge command. This user-requested plan optimization is documentation-only and does not complete runtime work. Each downloaded reference is a pinned behavioral oracle, never a linked runtime or permanent product dependency. Granite Speech 5.0 470M TurboCTC is the first offline ASR oracle; Nemotron 3.5 ASR native Safetensors is the second, streaming oracle; its incompatible Q8 GGUF remains explicitly rejected. FireRedVAD supplies segmentation evidence. Reuse internal/audiodsp, safetensors, tokenizer, hostmath/tensor, modelrecipe, capabilityruntime, dataset, evaluation, trainingprogram and trainingworkflow before adding owners. Shared execution means operation-named concrete components, even with one recipe consumer, not a new general-purpose graph engine. Model identity, tensor names, geometry, padding, normalization, weight sharing and composition belong in artifact/recipe declarations; no model-family dispatch in mathematical execution. Implement only demonstrated semantic gaps and bind each to a real recipe consumer in the same slice. Preserve one forward implementation for inference and training; checkpoint, optimizer, scheduler, resource and persistence ownership stay with the existing platform. First prove the complete processor tensor, then layer/logit/token/transcript parity, then admitted offline recipe execution and early WER/CER/resource measurements. Static DSP parity is not ASR parity, and transport chunking is not native streaming. The first train-evaluate-publish-serve proof is CPU-only with an explicit frozen-base output adapter and exact stop and resume preserving optimizer, random, scheduler and data-stream state. It includes VAD composition, a pre/post WER bracket, bounded resource measurements and complete OvergoDB lineage, but does not wait for full-encoder gradients, streaming ASR, another architecture, voice expansion or CUDA. Full-encoder training, second-architecture/native streaming, alignment, diarization, voice and generative audio remain open capabilities, not discarded scope. CPU is the numerical authority; CUDA follows measured bottlenecks through kernels/manifest.json. While GPU capacity is occupied, execute eligible CPU work; commit gates may use the GPU when their derived scope requires it. Unsupported or unavailable device execution is never passing evidence. Admission decodes actual samples and quarantines policy-invalid, silent, near-silent, corrupt, clipped or non-finite records. Reference text is isolated from prediction. Pinned LibriSpeech clean is the initial positive corpus. The historically silent AMI materialization remains quarantined until exact source/transformation identity is established; the non-silent original source does not clear it. The historical audio inspection batch-key finding remains open until canonical replay is repaired and verified; isolated-store success is not repair. Use one source-bound golden corpus, independent boundary traces and explicit tolerances across inference, evaluation and training. Reject unsupported behavior rather than silently approximating it. Preserve tied weights, cancellation, memory bounds, deterministic splits, restart state and failure denominators. Measure numerical error, allocations, wall time and host memory before claiming simplification or speed; direct DFT remains a reference, not FFT performance. Prefer caller-owned buffers and single-clip synchronous execution until batching or concurrency removes measured cost. Do not add a second loader, registry, scheduler, dataset cache, optimizer, checkpoint format, service or verifier framework. Retain broad platform benchmarks and recovery drills after the audio proof; they do not gate first CPU capability. Findings outside the audio scope are recorded without expanding it.

items.title: Deliver the first native CPU ASR capability

steps.title: Compose the complete CPU processor and encoder from shared operators, then prove deterministic CTC transcription
steps.rationale: Use three acceptance boundaries within one implementation slice: complete processor tensor (declared delta, frame stacking, trailing waveform padding and pre-transform frame selection); loaded encoder with per-layer/logit parity; greedy CTC IDs and tokenizer text on pinned audio. Reuse audiodsp, safetensors, tokenizer and hostmath/tensor through a thin concrete speechrecognition orchestrator with an existing recipe-compatible call boundary; no standalone service or new graph language. Recipe data supplies tensor-role bindings, operation order, shapes, normalization, padding, relative-position semantics, pooling and shared parameter identity. Existing additive bucket-bias attention is not query-dependent relative-position attention; causal convolution is not symmetric depthwise convolution. Add only proven gaps to the owning math component, with an independent golden for each. Keep the same forward function for future training, with explicit trainable boundaries and optional trace storage, not a second forward implementation. Start with one bounded clip and reusable workspace; defer batching, caching and fusion until measurement justifies them. Preserve all original checkpoint behavior, including intermediate CTC feedback and tied output projection. No Python runtime dependency or model-specific execution code.

Evaluation plans bind prompting protocol so unlike passes cannot overwrite one identity. The raw-completion MMLU anchor remains comparable with lm-eval. Master d75d3554 completed the generated-letter protocol by parsing chat-template control tokens as special tokens and recognizing end-of-generation markers by token name; cc4485a0 records the corrected MMLU comparison. Master c36e5b70 renders BBH, MuSR and other text candidates as lettered options while leaving existing letter candidates direct; 4a642032 refuses an unrenderable suite at plan time, prints the first generated answer and its candidates, and stops after an all-unmatched eight-case probe instead of recording zero. Master 03f08dd2 drops instantiated CUDA graph execs whenever captured device memory is released; complete Qwen3.5 4B and 9B chat-template passes must cross the prior BBH failure windows and therefore serve as the long-run replay-safety proof as well as quality measurements. The generated report derives all servable models and their latest per-protocol evidence from OvergoDB, prints missing measurements, and keeps published references as sourced declarations.
